text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The National Democratic Rally (RND) says it would contest every seat in the June 5 parliamentary elections.
- The RND has to work minor miracles to claim it has supporters in the country's 48 provinces only 21 days after it was created.
- The authorities will install on Wednesday the independent committee to supervise the legislative elections.
- Workers' union want more than 40 percent salary rise for state servants.
- About 160 theft cases reported in Algiers port.
- National Liberation Front urges members to respect party discipline.
